## Design

### 2026-10-09 – I finished the Week 1 project, Starbie. Here is what the finished product looked like for me:

**10h**

I finished the Week 1 project, Starbie. Here is what the finished product looked like for me:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 9.54.43 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/b8a78e2bcf517ab6f6f0a56f6aa2ae09c8643c491128ae002b5bc2417f1706ce.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 10.22.46 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/5a5e722e15d58015b7165248e8537151f6f5afe85382efaa782777ee605d88d9.png)

I started by going to the Github page and following the [guide](https://github.com/SharKingStudios/Starbie/blob/main/Week%201%20Guide.md). It was a little confusing though, since I had no prior experience going into this. I followed the steps and got stuck a few times, but Google helped me out. Eventually, I was able to finish the schematic:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 5.00.42 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/d93bfa24388898465a2f6fd2684044ff6df4e31f9078bbd227c90727cfaea52d.png)

After I brought it to the PCB editor, it was a bit of a mess:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 5.16.39 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/cc5e876a9ab76c8a2aad96dd8af2c060d5149eb6a3379930bbd1efe1c827916f.png)

After a few hours of struggling, I managed to route the PCB:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 6.11.15 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/5043d5c65a7086026e3cf491fbba353d0ecfa72cb29b677ae9bda7c4352b80ff.png)

 However I did get some errors:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 6.27.48 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/89693ec68a534971f05ecfd7ec3bf0d17dea9694ce2e4e15d08838640c11b0c3.png)

Eventually, I managed to fix the errors by using the copper fill, and finish the routing:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 9.26.26 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/18ecf087b46ea73953566bddccfcc4ca1d23e07ae1f101716c2512651de44de7.png)

As you saw in the previous image, I decided to use the Image Converter and add my designs. I liked the robot in the example, so I used that, and I also decided to add my name. I wanted them to be hand drawn, so these ended up being the designs:

![Name](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/e7bdb0238387b5e60843fd8f0400bdb64fe2b426685adcd08b1ab7e5e42eba54.png)

![Robot](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/0c2db2e37f1187bb4daaaa89d16f847b5e46dbc7c8cd425c3173ff73dab825d6.png)

Then, I went and used the code on the Github page and installed the libraries it wanted me to:

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 10.45.41 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/384aa24cbe5d70803bafaf9b5723a732cb7ac863c72110294f2a6b08b130fc9e.png)

This project took me a while since this was my first time doing something like this, so I got stuck a lot.
